refnamediv.refpurpose: Frontend API for generating system reports. This interface is implemented by systemd-report, which aggregates the metrics exposed by the io.systemd.Metrics services linked into /run/systemd/report/.

refsect1.title: Description
refsect1.para: io.systemd.Report is a Varlink interface implemented by systemd1-related components. It can be introspected and called with varlinkctl1.
Frontend API for generating system reports. This interface is implemented by systemd-report, which aggregates the metrics exposed by the io.systemd.Metrics services linked into /run/systemd/report/.

refsect1.title: Interface Definition
refsect1.para: The following interface definition is exposed:
refsect1.programlisting:
# Frontend API for generating system reports. This interface is implemented by systemd-report, which aggregates the metrics exposed by the io.systemd.Metrics services linked into /run/systemd/report/. interface io.systemd.Report
# Policy for how multiple signers are aggregated. type SignMode( # Emit whatever signatures are available, never fail on signing. bestEffort, # Require at least one signature; tolerate individual signer failures. (Default.) requireOne, # Require every signing mechanism to succeed with a signature. requireAll )
# Generate a report and return it as a JSON object. method Generate( # Selects which metrics to include in the report, as an array of metric family names or prefixes thereof. If unset or empty all available metrics are included. This matches the [MATCH…] arguments of the systemd-report command line tool. matches: ?[]string ) -> ( # The generated report as a JSON object. This mode does not sign the report, hence a precise binary formatting of the JSON data is not relevant. report: object )
# Generate a signed report and return it Base64 encoded. method GenerateSigned( # Selects which metrics to include in the report, as an array of metric family names or prefixes thereof. If unset or empty all available metrics are included. This matches the [MATCH…] arguments of the systemd-report command line tool. matches: ?[]string, # How to handle multiple signers. Defaults to requireOne if unset. mode: ?SignMode ) -> ( # The generated, signed report in Base64. A precise binary formatting of the JSON data is important to authenticate the signature. This data contains a JSON-SEQ compliant stream of objects, the first being the report, the following ones signature objects. reportData: string )

refsect1.title: Examples
refsect1.para: varlinkctl introspect SERVICE io.systemd.Report shows the interface definition as served by SERVICE, and varlinkctl call SERVICE io.systemd.Report.Generate '{}' invokes its Generate() method.

refsect1.title: History
refsect1.para: The io.systemd.Report interface was added in version 261.
Generate(), and GenerateSigned() were added in version 261.
